h1: Write a Python function `merge_intervals(intervals)` that takes a list of [start, end] integer intervals (possibly unsorted) and returns a new list of non-overlapping intervals covering the same ranges, merging any that overlap OR merely touch (e.g. [1,4] and [4,5] -> [1,5]). Return ONLY a python code block.
h2: Write a Python function `eval_rpn(tokens)` that evaluates an arithmetic expression in Reverse Polish Notation given as a list of string tokens (operators are + - * /, operands are integers that may be negative). Division must TRUNCATE TOWARD ZERO (so -7/2 is -3, not -4). Return the integer result. Return ONLY a python code block.
h3: Write a Python function `longest_palindromic_substring(s)` that returns the longest contiguous substring of s that is a palindrome (return any one if there is a tie). It must handle strings of length up to 2000 efficiently (do not use an O(n^3) approach). Return ONLY a python code block.
